candidateBinding.scope: Stage D adds exactly two model records and two comparison records; shared model/compare rendering, focused verifier, roadmap/registry and evidence changed. No additional public route family was introduced.

modelSelection.rationale: Independent acceptance of exact-version technical facts, first-party sources, metadata, interlinking and HTTP behavior.

checks.name: fixed candidate and complete diff
checks.evidence: git rev-parse HEAD matched the candidate; git status was clean before QA; full 7daa548..candidate name-status and content diff reviewed.

checks.name: first-party Sonnet 5.5 facts
checks.evidence: Anthropic owner documentation states model ID claude-sonnet-5-5, 1M context, USD 2/10 per MTok, Active status and release September 28 2026. The Anthropic announcement independently carries the same date and price.

checks.name: first-party Muse Wonder facts
checks.evidence: Meta owner docs state model ID muse-wonder-1.0, 1,048,576-token context, Preview, Standard-mode pay-as-you-go USD 4/20, release announcement October 12 2026, and explicitly state max effort does not select Muse Wonder Full. Cursor is retained only as the named CursorBench harness source, not as the model/pricing authority.

checks.name: focused automated verifier
checks.evidence: PIVOT-04 stage D passed: 16 models, 43 sitemap URLs, 15 comparisons, no orphan models.

checks.name: build
checks.evidence: Reused candidate-bound developer Next build evidence reporting 115 generated routes. Independent QA did not rebuild because the contract authorizes reuse and targeted HTTP exercised the resulting build.

checks.name: four approved public pages
checks.evidence: Local next start returned 200 for both new model pages and both new comparison pages. Each rendered one distinct Title, one H1 and the expected self-canonical. Unapproved /compare/claude-sonnet-5-5-vs-opus-5-5 returned 404.

checks.name: facts rendered with collection dates and owner sources
checks.evidence: Rendered pages showed 2026-11-15 checked dates, exact model IDs/status/context/prices, Meta max-versus-Full warning, and links to Anthropic or Meta owner sources. SourceList de-duplicates source inventory URLs; comparison pages had no duplicate source-list URL.

checks.name: quality comparison boundaries
checks.evidence: Muse vs GPT explicitly says no cited common harness and shows no direct quality score. Sonnet vs Opus identifies the genuine common exact-version CursorBench 4.0 harness and limits it as harness-specific rather than a universal ranking; the shared quality-evidence warning requires same prompts/tools/budgets/judge.

checks.name: bidirectional and relevant interlinking
checks.evidence: Both new model pages link their approved comparison; Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.2 model pages link back to the corresponding new comparison. More-comparisons logic is endpoint membership based. Focused verifier confirmed all 16 models have a comparison and no orphan.

checks.name: inventory and route regression boundary
checks.evidence: Rendered sitemap contained exactly 43 loc entries, including 16 /models/ and 15 /compare/ entries. /guides and /guides/ returned 410; /examples returned a single 301 to /; /checks returned a single 301 to /leaderboard; unknown returned 404; /api/health returned 200 JSON.

checks.name: whitespace and evidence integrity
checks.evidence: Exited 0 before evidence creation; original developer and earlier-stage QA evidence was preserved.
